text: And Bildaḏ the Shuḥite answered and said,
“Rule and fear belong to Him, making peace in His high places.
Is there any number to His armies? And on whom does His light not rise?
So how could man be righteous before Ěl? Or how could he be flawless who is born of a woman?
See, even the moon does not shine, and the stars have not been flawless in His eyes,
how much less man, a maggot, and a son of man, a worm?”
